2014_spells.silvery-barbs.description: You magically distract a creature within range that you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn. If the target fails, you can choose a different creature you can see within range (including yourself). That creature has advantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

That creature has advantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn; You magically distract a creature within range that you can see.
